title: Patient Services Courtesy Guidance: Appointment Record and Genetic Cancellation Fees
content:
A patient's record with Specimen Collection Appointments earns a courtesy that is subtracted from the genetic cancellation handling fee on a Laboratory Test Orders accession of the Hereditary & Reproductive Genetic Testing class.

**Clause.**

- When the patient's collection visits show no no-show fee and no late-cancellation fee assessed in the 12 months before today, and the patient has at least one collection visit with status *collected*, **8.00** is subtracted from the handling fee.
- When they show exactly one such fee assessed in those 12 months, and at least one collected visit, **4.00** is subtracted from the handling fee.
- Any other visit record has no courtesy subtracted.

| No-show and late-cancellation fees assessed in the last 12 months | At least one collected visit | Subtracted from the handling fee |
|---|---|---|
| None | Yes | 8.00 |
| Exactly one | Yes | 4.00 |
| Two or more | Either | nothing |
| Any number | No | nothing |

**Cases (hypothetical).**

1. Three collected visits and no missed-appointment fee in the past year: 8.00.
2. One collected visit and one no-show fee assessed eight months ago: 4.00.
3. No collected visit at all: nothing, whatever the fee record.
4. A late-cancellation fee assessed 14 months ago and two collected visits: the fee falls outside the 12 months, so 8.00.
